sections.title: 1. Design Summary
sections.prompt: In 2–5 sentences: the chosen design, and why it meets every target without worsening any accepted or deferred impact.

fields.name: Source
fields.prompt: Where the Input states the target, with its id there if it has one

fields.name: Statement
fields.prompt: The target, including any condition under which it applies and any verification it requires

fields.name: Touches
fields.prompt: Exact file paths and symbols, e.g. `src/a.py` (`parse`, `Config.load`)

fields.name: Behavior
fields.prompt: Expected behavior once the step is done, with no open choices

fields.name: Method
fields.prompt: Exact command or action, observable from outside the component

fields.name: Expected
fields.prompt: Observable result that means the check passes

fields.name: Verifies
fields.prompt: Target ids it verifies, e.g. T1, T2, or "None"

fields.name: Claim
fields.prompt: What already holds, with no change needed

fields.name: Evidence
fields.prompt: File paths, symbols, or references that prove it

sections.title: 6. Traceability
sections.item_schema: <target id> — Met by: <step or certification ids, or None> — Checks: <check ids, or None>
